decision.reason: [ev-af4f90a534ca] says that the "write dedupe cache" is deprecated and that it isn't needed with TSDB or boltdb-shipper. It doesn't name the configuration key, flag or values path for that cache, so the subject can't be pinned to a concrete setting. It also doesn't say which configuration enables the cache, so the condition for an exposed environment (applicability) can't be written. The excerpt also adds a separate requirement, that legacy index types must migrate to TSDB before Loki 4.0, which makes it less clear what this one change covers. We need the config reference or the pull request that names the write dedupe cache setting.
